# AI Skill Shield

> AI Skill Shield is a web-based security validator for AI agent skills. It reviews SKILL.md content, uploaded skill packages, and public GitHub repositories before installation.

## Primary pages

- [Validate an AI agent skill](https://ai-skill-shield.suppeng.com/): Upload files, paste SKILL.md, or audit a GitHub repository.
- [Compare AI agent skills](https://ai-skill-shield.suppeng.com/compare): Compare validation scores, risk levels, and security findings.
- [Security policy rules](https://ai-skill-shield.suppeng.com/rules): Review and configure validation policy options.
- [API documentation](https://ai-skill-shield.suppeng.com/docs/api): Integrate validation, repository audits, policies, and reports.

## What AI Skill Shield checks

- Secrets and credential exposure
- Destructive commands and shell-execution risk
- External network access and domains
- Install scripts, workflows, registries, and submodules
- Compatibility across supported AI agent ecosystems
- Permission declarations and install risk

## Publisher

AI Skill Shield is made by [Support Engine](https://suppeng.com/) in Bangladesh.
